subject: Hiring packet draft: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer — comp band, sign-on, start
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer packet for Michael Chen (Sr. MLE) — needing comp-band & headcount sign-off

Hi all,

Attached is my initial draft of the offer packet for Michael Chen (senior ML eng candidate, ex-AI startup). Mike verbally accepted the role in the phone call yesterday but asked for a written offer to review.

What's included: JD_Sr_MLE_v3.pdf and offer_draft_v1.docx (base, equity, 4-yr vesting with 1y cliff, standard IP/Confidentiality, background contingent).

Asks:
- Markus: confirmation that the proposed comp band (base $190k, target OTE $260k with 15% sign-on) fits the hiring budget and that headcount is approved to start in July.
- Aditya/Finance: confirm affordability against FY26 hiring plan and if sign-on at 15% needs extra approval.
- Laura/People Ops: please check start date options (July 19 or Aug 2) and relocation stipend policy.
- Mina/Legal: any immediate redline flags on the IP/termination language?

I'll pause before sending the external offer until we have comp/finance sign-off and legal redlines.

Thanks,

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Attachment: JD_Sr_MLE_v3.pdf, offer_draft_v1.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft offer packet for Michael Chen (Sr. MLE) — needing comp-band & headcount sign-off

Thanks Priyom — quick thoughts from the hiring side:

1) Comp band is fine to me at the top half; I recommend we position base at $195,000 and make the equity slightly higher (extra 3k RSU annualized) to land him in upper quartile of our band. He's got rare infra + research experience.

2) Sign-on: I'd prefer a two-part sign-on (cash + equity kicker) rather than a single percentage; helps if we prorate if start is delayed.

3) Start date: we should push for July 19, but candidate signaled he may need a 4-week notice period (prefers Aug 2). If we can offer a flexible start with a smaller initial sign-on if Aug 2 holds, I'd do that.

4) Relocation: recommend a flat lump-sum relocation of $10k (no assistance program) — simpler operationally.

If Finance objects, we can drop the RSU kicker and keep base at $190k. Please let me know budget status.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Machine Learning Engineering

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft offer packet for Michael Chen (Sr. MLE) — needing comp-band & headcount sign-off

Quick finance check — headcount for Q3 was approved for an additional 4 senior ICs in ML (headcount code H3-ML-Q3). We have baseline budget for base + target equity within the band you proposed, Markus, but two caveats:

1) Anything above a 12% cash sign-on requires Director of Finance approval (beyond hiring manager sign-off).
2) The RSU kicker needs to be absorbed against the equity pool; if we exceed the allocated pool for the quarter we will request an exception.

If you want the base up to $195k and an extra 3k RSU/year, I need you to confirm which of these we prefer to prioritize: cash sign-on vs equity kicker. If you pick equity, Finance can usually approve without extra sign-off; cash above 12% triggers a quick finance review.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Finance Partner — Talent & Compensation

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft offer packet for Michael Chen (Sr. MLE) — needing comp-band & headcount sign-off

I've attached a redline of the offer_draft_v1.docx with legal comments (offer_redline_legal.docx). Summary of notable items:

• IP assignment: tighten the language around pre-existing inventions carve-out — candidate needs clarity on consulting exceptions; we should offer a simple disclosure carve-out form.
• Termination/severance: our standard is 8 weeks for SVP/higher; for senior ICs we usually do 4 weeks if involuntary without cause. Confirm if we want to offer any enhanced severance.
• Background check: keep contingent language but specify the timeline for completion.
• Non-solicit: limit to 12 months and no geographic scope.

If you want me to clean the language for candidate-facing copy, I can prepare a version with tracked changes accepted.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: offer_redline_legal.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@gmail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Inference — written offer (Sr. Machine Learning Engineer)

Hi Michael — great talking yesterday. We're excited about the possibility of you joining Redwood. Attached is the initial written offer for your review (offer_draft_v1.docx).

High-level terms in the draft:
- Role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (IC)
- Base: $190,000
- Target OTE: ~$260,000 (base + target bonus + RSUs)
- Equity: 4-year vesting, 1-year cliff (details in doc)
- Sign-on: proposed 12% cash sign-on (we are discussing an equity kicker internally)
- Start: tentative July 19 (we can accommodate Aug 2 if necessary)
- Relocation: proposed $10,000 lump sum; remote-first but occasional onsite expected

Please review and let me know any items you'd like to discuss. If these look broadly OK I can get final approvals and send a candidate-facing offer with tracked legal language.

Best regards,

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Attachment: offer_draft_v1.docx

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@gmail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — written offer (Sr. Machine Learning Engineer)

Hi Priyom — thanks for sending this over and for the call. I appreciate the clarity. A few points from my side:

1) Start date: I can do Aug 2 reliably (company notice period + a small relocation window).
2) Sign-on: I would prefer a mix of cash + equity (cash preferred for initial move costs). If cash must be capped at 12%, an additional small equity kicker would be helpful.
3) Equity vesting: can we confirm a standard 4-year schedule but shift the first 25% cliff to 9 months instead of 12? That would help alignment given my prior grant schedule.
4) Relocation: $10k lump sum sounds reasonable — appreciate confirmation it is tax gross-up neutral.
5) IP carve-out: happy to fill a disclosure form for grandfathered consulting work; need to see the candidate-facing wording before signing.

Happy to sign once we settle the cash/equity split and finalize the IP carve-out language. Available for a call Monday morning if helpful.

Best,
Michael
Michael Chen
(michael.chen@gmail.com)
